summary: This article explains how the 206 bones of the skeleton support the body, protect organs, work with muscles at joints, make blood, heal, and stay strong.
introduce: Ask students to share a small problem they solved this week and how they solved it, and write two examples in a Problem | Solution chart on the board. Tell them that “The Human Skeleton” also has a problem and a solution to find.

keyTerms.def: all the bones of a body joined together
the small bones that are stacked to make the spine (one is a vertebra)
the soft material inside many bones that makes blood cells

challengeTerms.def: a strong structure that supports something and gives it shape
a tough band of tissue that holds bones together
to join together and become one

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that bones are just hard, lifeless parts of the body? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain how bones and muscles work together to help you move.
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review skeleton, vertebrae, and marrow, and let weak readers fill in a simple Problem | Solution chart with sentence starters.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use framework, ligament, and fuse in a short paragraph that suggests a second solution to the problem and judge which works better.
